question: Why did the Indigofera powder have the highest moisture content of the three dyes?
expect: premise false: Indigofera had the lowest moisture content (9.87%), though the highest water activity (0.6436) (Table 1)
rendered:
Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation, page 7
